decisions.decision: Keep the released / route unchanged until the replacement is ready.
decisions.rationale: The new CMS preview must prove parity and safety before public cutover.

decisions.decision: Render /content-review from one typed teacher-facing document.
decisions.rationale: Copy, section order, and product screenshots must not come from separate route-local graphs.

decisions.decision: Keep CMS IDs, review rationale, governance, and destinations server-only.
decisions.rationale: The teacher preview must contain teacher content only, and hydration must not expose internal identity or reviewer material.

decisions.decision: Pair story copy and screenshots by semantic server-only bindings.
decisions.rationale: Reordering source records must not silently attach the wrong screen to a story step.

decisions.decision: Use bounded section layouts rather than a free-form website builder.
decisions.rationale: This release needs a safe CMS-shaped editing path without making layout authoring a separate product.

verification.postbuild: content-review output and / isolation guards passed
verification.browser: No horizontal overflow at 320, 768, or 1280px; one main and one H1; canonical section order present

infrastructure.dev_server: Existing workspace server remains available at http://localhost:3000; temporary port 3002 server was stopped.
infrastructure.node_note: Repository requests Node 24.x; verification ran under Node 25.9.0 and passed.

next_action: Start the persistence phase by inspecting the deployment database options and adding a validated PostgreSQL/Drizzle schema without touching the released / route.
context_notes: The first safe slice is complete. Do not claim Save, undo, version history, restore, publishing, or durable comments exist yet; those are later phases. The existing review panel and direct-edit prototype remain in place while the CMS model is built behind the replacement preview.
